name: Jezero Delta Front
note: Ancient river delta, prime target for signs of past life

name: Seitah Formation
note: Layered rock with possible igneous history

name: Carbonate Outcrop
note: Carbonate minerals that form in water

name: Clay Outcrop
note: Clay minerals that preserve organic material

name: Neretva Vallis inlet
note: Ancient river valley that once carried water into Jezero lake

name: Nili Fossae troughs
note: Exposed carbonate, clay and olivine-rich rocks that record early water-rich conditions

name: Gale weather station
note: Curiosity's weather instrument tracks daily and seasonal pressure, temperature and humidity here

name: Yellowknife Bay
note: Ancient lakebed where Curiosity found conditions that could have supported microbial life

name: Bagnold Dunes
note: Active dunes where wind-driven sand movement on Mars can be studied up close

name: Clay-to-sulfate layers
note: Mount Sharp's layers shift from clay-rich to sulfate-rich rock, a record of Mars drying out

name: Mount Sharp upper layers
note: A tall stack of layered rock holding the youngest part of Gale's history
